name: Cavalier Charioteer
body:
The chariot careened away from the enemies front line, racing for their flank. The charioteer strained against the reins, roaring insults as he drove across the line. He swung around the line’s outer edge and crashed into the exposed infantry. Bodies flew in all directions and the charioteer swept around for another pass.

During the bronze age, the chariot represented the cutting edge of war technology. It could be found on battlefields for over 1,500 years. Even as late as the time of Caesar, the enemies of Rome still employed the chariot. Whether in a bronze age setting, or a game heavy on flare, the charioteer stands ready to wreak havoc on the battlefield.

Mount (Ex)

Instead of a single mount, the charioteer pilots a chariot driven by two mounts. The mounts only function in combat is driving the chariot. Instead, the chariot may function in an offensive capacity. The cavalier’s chariot is armed with two small daggers attached to each of its axle caps, which can be used to execute special attacks. The blades do 2d3 + 1 per 2 cavalier levels slashing damage and can be upgraded to masterworks and enchanted. For the purpose of choosing feats and the cavalier’s expert trainer ability, the companions are considered to have, and benefit from, the same feats and tricks.

Order

The charioteer must belong to the order of the chariot.

Ride-by Attack (Ex)

The charioteer receives Ride-by Attack as a bonus feat. For the purpose of combat, cavalier abilities and all mounted feats, the charioteer is considered mounted when driving a chariot.

This ability replaces tactician.

Thundering Rampage (Ex)

At 5th level, a charioteer’s banner becomes a symbol of doom to his enemies. As long as the cavalier’s banner is clearly visible, all enemies within 60 feet receive a -2 morale penalty on saving throws against fear and a -1 morale penalty on attack rolls. At 10th level, and every five levels thereafter, these penalties increase by -1. The banner must be at least small or larger and must be carried or displayed on the cavalier’s chariot.

This ability alters banner.

Improved Ride-by Attack (Ex)

At 9th level, when making a successful attack against a target during a Drive-by Attack, the charioteer makes one additional attack against the target at his highest BAB, using the chariot’s bladed axle caps. The blades do 2d3 + 1 per 2 cavalier levels slashing damage.

Rolling Thunder (Ex)

At 17th level, the charioteer gains +2 on attack and damage rolls made while performing Drive-by Attacks with a chariot.
